key_insight: Deeper gradient-trained parameterized quantum circuits can show double descent, meaning test performance may improve again as model size grows.
engineering_relevance: This suggests scaling up PQCs is not automatically harmful for generalization, which is encouraging for designing larger quantum models in practice.
method: Derived analytical generalization behavior using add-one-in perturbation techniques.
Analyzed spectral properties of random matrices to rigorously support the theory.
Validated the prediction with numerical experiments on re-uploading PQCs.
evidence_signal: Experiments across several datasets and training set sizes consistently observed the predicted double descent behavior in re-uploading PQCs.
watch_item: The result does not remove other practical obstacles in quantum machine learning, so larger circuits still require careful optimization and hardware-aware validation.
paper_title: Cautious optimism for deep parameterized quantum circuits
